data.gender_notes: Khirad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khiraj' meaning 'to be hidden' or 'to conceal'. Khirad is a name of wisdom, intelligence, and enlightenment. In Islamic tradition, it represents the inner light of knowledge and understanding. The name Khirad carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khirad usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
